title: UCVE: Graph Structured Retrieval for Compliance Validation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structured compliance validation requires determining whether every obligation in a predefined requirement space is satisfied, violated, or unaddressed by a given document. This can be described as a coverage problem that existing retrieval and classification systems, by treating requirements as independent, are not designed to solve. We introduce \textbf{\ac{UCVE}}, a domain-agnostic framework that represents compliance requirement spaces as a \ac{CRG} and performs retrieval via spectral reranking over its reinforcement learning-weighted Laplacian. Edges between requirement nodes are learned via reinforcement learning with a traversal reward grounded in violation detection, reshaping the graph's community structure such that low-pass spectral filtering distinguishes relevant from irrelevant obligation clusters. translated_title: UCVE：用于合规性验证的图结构检索
translated_abstract: 结构化合规性验证需要判断预定义需求空间中的每项义务在给定文档中是被满足、被违反还是未被涉及。这可以被描述为一个覆盖问题，而现有的检索与分类系统由于将需求视为相互独立，并未针对解决这一问题而设计。我们提出了UCVE，一个领域无关的框架，它将合规需求空间表示为合规需求图（CRG），并通过在其经强化学习加权的拉普拉斯矩阵上进行谱重排序来执行检索。需求节点之间的边通过强化学习习得，其遍历奖励以违规检测为基础，从而重塑图的社区结构，使得低通谱滤波能够有效区分相关与不相关的义务簇。在三个合规领域的评估中，UCVE相比平面余弦检索平均提升了4.3%的matched-K召回率……
tldr: UCVE提出了一种领域无关的合规验证框架，将合规验证建模为覆盖问题，通过强化学习构建加权合规需求图并利用谱重排序检索，相比传统余弦检索平均提升4.3%的召回率。
